summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — attested only in the Epitome list of wooers who came against Odysseus' house.

story.text: Apollodorus names Ormenius among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Thrasymedes and before Diopithes in the long company of Penelope's wooers — a Thrasymedes in the same list whom the Epitome does not identify with Nestor's son.
